_what: PRE-REGISTRATION. Written and committed BEFORE run A4 is staged, per line 6 of the contract frozen by teacherbot@blue: 'Record the expected result for each luna cell before the run starts.'
_why: openai/gpt-5.6-luna is a CONTROL in A4, not a new measurement. Its cells repeat run 30673119035 exactly — same probes, same n=25, same edition, graders unchanged. The question A4 asks of luna is not how it scores but whether the score REPRODUCES. Nothing in this repository has ever re-run an identical cell configuration, so the block-instability finding in RESULTS.md rests on within-run resampling only.
_the_guard: Writing the expected numbers down first is what makes the comparison honest. Committed before the run, a divergence cannot be reinterpreted after it, in either direction. This exists because the customer said, before the run, that they hoped some numbers would come in low — a legitimate wish for dynamic range, and exactly the condition under which a post-hoc reading of the result would be untrustworthy.
_inverted_for_the_control: For the five OTHER models a low number is a finding about the model. For luna a low number is a finding about the INSTRUMENT: it would mean an identical configuration does not reproduce, which would put every rate in RESULTS.md in question, including the ones already reported.
_interval_method: Normal approximation to the binomial at n=25, +/-2 SD, rounded and clamped to [0,25]. Deliberately crude and stated as such. It is a pre-committed tolerance, not a significance test.
_falsification: A luna cell landing OUTSIDE its interval is recorded as a replication failure for that probe. Three or more outside intervals is recorded as the instrument failing to reproduce, and RESULTS.md's rates get a caveat naming this run.
_no_prediction_why: gemma-4-31b-it and gpt-5.6-luna-pro have ZERO committed cells. The other three have only small-n cells, which A2 showed are draws rather than rates. There is nothing to predict from, and inventing a prediction would be the vibes elicitation P5 exists to catch.
